UI_trait_OnYourToesdesc:
Light on your feet. Boosts your Nimble skill by 1.

(Only overhauls your pivoting if the trait toggle is enabled in this mod's sandbox settings. If it's disabled, pivoting is global for everyone and this trait is just a +1 Nimble add-on.)
UI_trait_PodShofedesc:
A few drinks deep and never quite sober. Lowers your Nimble skill by 1.

(Only overhauls your pivoting if the trait toggle is enabled in this mod's sandbox settings. If it's disabled, pivoting is global for everyone and this trait is just a -1 Nimble add-on.)
